text.tspan: CO-OP • SOLO • Your pocket city • 4/25 actors (0 AI) • 0 spectators
KEYS LIVE • WASD / arrows + SPACE • Esc releases
WASD / arrows: walk & climb • Space: punch • Esc: release • dodge marked lanes!
CO-OP: crew punches are safe. Climb 2, 4, 6; flatten towers, then boss.
Flatten all floors to expose the boss • HP loss, not fame • YOU: exact hit / TEAM: total
Solo practice: flatten three towers, then punch the boss! • Drag title to move • Close hides; Leave exits
BOSS RECOVERING • catch it on the ground
